name: 視線方向整合性
description: Detects unnatural eye gaze patterns in deepfake videos.
useCase: Identifying deepfakes through eye symmetry analysis
mechanism: Analyzes texture symmetry between left and right eye regions. Deepfakes often generate asymmetric eye patterns due to imperfect gaze rendering.
source: Matern et al. (2019) - Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes
algorithm: Eye Region Symmetry + Texture Variance Analysis
parameters: Block size: adaptive, Analysis region: face/body, Metrics: gradient energy, variance ratio
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated video artifacts
- Works across different video resolutions
- Complements other forensic analysis methods
- Low computational overhead per frame
limitations:
- Requires video input (not applicable to images)
- May produce false positives on heavily processed videos
- Performance varies with video quality
- Single-frame analysis limits temporal assessment

references.title: Matern et al. (2019) - Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes
Ciftci, U. et al. (2020). FakeCatcher: Detection of Synthetic Portrait Videos using Biological Signals. IEEE TPAMI.
Yang, X. et al. (2019). Exposing Deep Fakes Using Inconsistent Head Poses. ICASSP.
